scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && node scripts/prepare-sites-build.mjs
scripts.build:service-host: node scripts/prepare-tauri-resources.mjs && cargo build --release --bin sugrid-inventory-service --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && node scripts/prepare-service-host.mjs
scripts.build:updater: cargo build --release --bin sugrid-inventory-updater --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && node scripts/prepare-updater.mjs
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build:service-host && npm run build:updater && tauri build
